items.raw_excerpt: Aboriginal leaders in WA's north have urged the state government to provide more support for fetal alcohol spectrum disorder.
items.summary_en: Aboriginal leaders in northern Western Australia have asked the state government to give more support for fetal alcohol spectrum disorder (FASD). They say families in the Kimberley region need more help. They are asking for earlier diagnosis and better services close to home.
items.summary_ko: 서호주 북부의 원주민 지도자들이 주 정부에 태아 알코올 스펙트럼 장애(FASD)에 대한 지원을 늘려달라고 요청했습니다. 킴벌리 지역 가족들이 더 많은 도움을 필요로 한다고 밝혔습니다. 아이들의 조기 진단과 지역 내 더 나은 서비스를 원하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: A small town asks for more FASD support

items.title_original: Fitzroy Crossing calls for stronger FASD support

items.raw_excerpt: A proposed residential development in South Lancaster could bring 52 new housing units to the village. Township council is set to consider the application.
items.summary_en: A new residential plan could bring 52 housing units to the village of South Lancaster in Ontario, Canada. Township council will soon review the application. Some people worry it may change the village's rural character.

items.title_en: Proposal could bring 52 new homes to small Canadian village

items.raw_excerpt: The Mexican government has just introduced a new resident of the National Palace. It’s a puppy, and his name is Rollo.
items.summary_en: The Mexican government brought a new puppy to the National Palace. The puppy is named Rollo and has one job: to support emotional well-being.

items.raw_excerpt: Paço do Frevo promoveu atividades especiais para celebrar o Dia Nacional do Frevo e mantém oficinas, vivências e apresentações gratuitas ao longo do mês
items.summary_en: Paço do Frevo hosted special activities to celebrate Brazil's National Frevo Day. Free workshops, hands-on sessions, and live performances continue all month long in Recife.
